description: Live TD stage options and windows for the selected well.
sql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  stage_num AS label,
  stage_num AS value,
  COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_start_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS timestamp)) AS stage_start_ts,
  COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS timestamp)) AS stage_end_ts,
  sample_count
FROM featurestore:nextier_copper_stage_index_v1 s
WHERE well_name = :well_name
  AND stage_num IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_start_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_start_ts AS timestamp)) IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(CAST(s.continuous_end_ts AS timestamp), CAST(s.stage_end_ts AS timestamp)) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY stage_num
) q
